title: The Position of Fuck You (John Goodman in The Gambler)
summary: A one-minute scene from The Gambler in which John Goodman's loan shark explains the 'position of f you': having enough money to walk away from any employer or deal.
why: HN links it whenever the discussion turns to layoffs, saving, and having enough financial independence to say no.

quote.text: This clip from the Gambler summed it up pretty well
